english_translation: The dog is barking outside; perhaps there is something it has seen.
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Imbwa' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 9 (i-/dzi-) Animal Noun).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'chayaoona' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -chayaoona (root)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
